name: app-investment-app-chart-with-orange-phone-project-cover
title: Project cover: orange phone with glowing chart and studio tag
whatItIs: A white project thumbnail with a tilted orange phone held in a hand showing a glowing lime chart, a dark circular nav bar, and a lime logo tile and studio name in the corners.
whatItMeans: Clear and clean; the orange hardware and lime chart give a recognisable, fresh pairing.
techniques: Use a bright hardware colour as the main graphic.
Angle the phone so the chart becomes a dynamic curve.
Keep the background almost white to focus attention.
Add a tiny logo tile and studio label in the corners.

vocabulary.definition: A small cover image for a portfolio piece.
A phone colour chosen as part of the composition.
Small branded label in a corner of the frame.
A chart line with a luminous halo.
